topic.label: Travel and Outdoors
topic.desc: Getting somewhere and being outside: trip and route planning, hiking, trails and parks, weather and conditions, bookings and permits.

concepts.label: Bookings and Permits
concepts.desc: Reservations, campsites, park permits, passes and entry requirements.

concepts.label: Weather and Conditions
concepts.desc: Weather forecasts, seasons, daylight and conditions that affect travel and outdoor plans.

concepts.label: Hiking, Trails and Parks
concepts.desc: Hikes and trails: finding a hike, distance, elevation gain, difficulty, trailheads and parks.

concepts.label: Trip and Route Planning
concepts.desc: Planning trips: destinations, itineraries, transport and routes between places.

skills.label: Permit Requirement Finder
skills.desc: Finds whether a park, trail or campsite needs a permit or reservation and how to get it.

skills.label: Conditions Check
skills.desc: Checks forecast, daylight and seasonal conditions for a place and date.

skills.label: Hike Finder
skills.desc: Finds hikes near a place by distance, elevation gain and difficulty, with trailhead coordinates.

skills.label: Trail Safety Briefing
skills.desc: Briefs the safety needs of a hike: water, daylight, weather, terrain and turnaround time.

skills.label: Itinerary Planner
skills.desc: Plans a day-by-day itinerary with travel times between stops.

mcp.name: Google Maps MCP
mcp.desc: Google Maps Platform MCP server: geocoding and reverse geocoding of addresses and coordinates, place search and place details, distance matrix, elevation and directions.

mcp.name: OpenStreetMap MCP
mcp.desc: OpenStreetMap MCP server: geocode addresses and place names to coordinates, find nearby places, route between locations, explore neighborhoods from open map data.
